about: Internal state of an eoc::aigrid::FloodRequestComponent: the handle of the AI-grid flood request that is running. Added by eoc::aigrid::FloodRequestSystem::ProcessNewRequests with the value returned by eoc::AiGrid::RequestFlood (ls::TypeWrapSimple<unsigned short, eoc::AiFloodRequest::HandleClassname>). Never seen alive. Registry total 2 (client and server rows).

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0xF2DD60 (AllocRaw 2) stores at +0 the 2-byte value its third argument points to. Game ProcessNewRequests bg3.exe+0xF2C150 calls it with the entity and a local handle filled by the AiGrid request allocator bg3.exe+0xE56070. Toolkit ProcessNewRequests: `AiGrid::RequestFlood(...)` returns ls::TypeWrapSimple<unsigned short, eoc::AiFloodRequest::HandleClassname> into a local variable, then adds this component with it (EoCShared.dll+0xE46310). macOS default strh (2 bytes).
